The stats are split into tiny, illegible fragments on both edges ('BT 5.4', '250 g' and '40 h' labels are unreadable), the subhead wraps to leave 'lab.' orphaned, the headphones lose their circle, and a stray circle fragment sits in the top-right corner. Still, the logo, headline and CTA keep a sensible hierarchy. B: the OBSIDIAN logo is blown up to rival the headline. The CTA pill jams into the subhead text and '40 h' collides with 'lab.'. The stat and legal text beside the headphones is microscopic, and the same stray circle fragment appears top-right, so the layout reads cramped and jumbled.
